items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard a lot of Willie Dixon and Muddy Waters

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I went to a blues promoter in Greenwood, in Mississippi, when I was
down there one time, and I heard a lot of Willie Dixon and Muddy Waters and all of the...
In listening to that, were you breaking down the lyrics?
